lines.speaker: A
lines.text: What does a camera sensor actually record, before any editing touches it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: RawAnalyser is Antoine's Python tool for looking at exactly that, on raw camera frames.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Clipping, per-channel values, gamma and vignetting. It computes clipping histograms and dynamic range, then turns them into diagnostic plots.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And how do you tell it where to look?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You choose regions of the image in a JSON file, so the analysis targets the patches you care about. It's a hands-on way to understand sensor data. The written page walks through the plots.
